category_title: Students with hyperactive-impulsive behaviors who disrupt classroom instruction
scenario_title: Completing written work in core academic subjects
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a regular classroom completing a timed math and spelling worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your desk and complete the math and spelling worksheet. You have 15 minutes to finish.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Constantly shifting in his place and fidgeting with his stationery items) I do not like written work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just focus on the paper and keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets up and starts walking in class, making noises) I want to hurry to finish!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to sit down. Your work is incomplete and you are not keeping pace with the other students.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pouts and starts crying easily) I can't do it! (Leaves the incomplete work on the desk, looking easily irritated and frustrated)
